text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 08 · 临海长桌与凉廊.
Environment:  An empty intimate Mediterranean dining pergola above the sea, cream stone columns and light oak slat canopy with translucent ivory fabric diffusing the light. A long warm-brown table offset left, modest ceramic dishes, folded linen napkins and a glass water carafe, mismatched woven chairs. Pale gravel garden and olive tree to right; wide gap at center gives view to the sea and low coastal hills. Soft bright summer light, shallow low-contrast stripes only, tactile everyday luxury, no elaborate banquet excess.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 08 · 临海长桌与凉廊. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
